findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is b5a1e75ee766b30ee473e95e61e0e973416be5c76f35e958a79c7fe67d2dc5f3; all 6 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

The official plan PDF was retrieved at 971,223 bytes with SHA-256 c95d84641a0d024c04b9d8ba491e5972085b29a05a9aba4038128d78e8e12d01; it is unencrypted, has no JavaScript, contains 75 physical pages, and records creation on 2024-08-08 and modification on 2024-09-02.
Physical pages 44-45 describe annual comparison with income indicators, year-to-year changes, and Section 23.175 compliance, plus reassignment or experienced-appraiser review.

Physical page 45 calls appraisal-to-sales ratios preferred but says sales are very infrequent, conditions often are not public, and transactions normally cover multiple sites and mixed property and asset types.
Physical page 45 identifies valid single-property appraisals submitted for staff review as another comparison and says methods and procedures are subject to PTAD review.
Current official Texas sources support only the bounded statutory, MAP-program, local-value, and mass-appraisal review context stated in the article.
